name: web2music
description: Web2Music — mood-adaptive ambient music Chrome extension. Monorepo root: workspaces + shared Docker infra for Features A/B/D and the extension shell.

scripts.test: npm run test -w data-extraction && npm run test -w mood-classification && node mood-classification/fixture_staleness_test.js && node ui/offscreen_routing_test.js
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec -i web2music-db psql -U postgres -d audio_cache < docker/init.sql
scripts.db:schema: docker exec web2music-db psql -U postgres -d audio_cache -c "\d audio_cache"
